I just want to let everyone know that is interested in trying mdma or has tried mdxx that it <1--will-->could lose its luster and is extremely addictive in certain cases! I have been a dj for the past 10 years and use to go to raves and dance parties 3-4 times per week. I use to use mdxx every party I went to and then realized I should be there for the music not the mdxx. I wanted to fell that buzz and roll everyday...It's like heaven who wouldn't! I was eaten about 15 pills a week. It made me depressed as well as HUGE memory loss...I couldn't remember anything. It took 4 years of being clean to regain any of my memory back and the depression to subside.
